block.wayfarers.auto_harvester.desc: Harvests ripe crops around it and replants them.
block.wayfarers.auto_harvester.desc2: The harvest goes into a chest next to it.
block.wayfarers.block_breaker.desc: On a redstone pulse, breaks the block in front.
block.wayfarers.block_breaker.desc2: Drops go into the chest behind it.
block.wayfarers.block_breaker.desc3: Pair it with a Redstone Timer for tree and stone farms.
block.wayfarers.block_placer.desc: On a redstone pulse, places a block in front.
block.wayfarers.block_placer.desc2: Takes blocks from the chest behind, or its own slots.
block.wayfarers.boss_seal.desc: Heart of a boss arena (placed by dungeons): the boss wakes when you step inside.
block.wayfarers.chisel_table.desc: Use: put a stack of blocks in, click a variant to turn the whole stack into it, for free.
block.wayfarers.compacting_crate.desc: Holds 32 stacks of one item, shown on its front. Right-click: put in (twice quickly: all you carry). Left-click: take a stack.
block.wayfarers.entity_detector.desc: Outputs redstone while something is near (1 per creature, max 15).
block.wayfarers.entity_detector.desc3: Sneak-click: players, monsters, animals, items or all living.
block.wayfarers.grave.desc: Holds the belongings of a fallen wayfarer.
block.wayfarers.guild_terminal.desc: Use: browse and search every chest within 12 blocks in one grid. Sneak-use: sort them all.
block.wayfarers.mist_gate.desc: Walk through it to face the boss; it seals behind you until the fight ends.
block.wayfarers.redstone_timer.desc: Sends a short redstone pulse every few seconds.
block.wayfarers.sorting_chest.desc: 54 slots. Sorts itself and vacuums nearby items.
block.wayfarers.sprinkler.desc: Place it among your crops: plants below grow faster.
block.wayfarers.sprinkler.desc2: Keeps farmland wet, no water needed.
block.wayfarers.vacuum_hopper.desc: Pulls in items and experience nearby.
block.wayfarers.vacuum_hopper.desc2: Feeds the chest below it; click it to take the XP.
block.wayfarers.vacuum_hopper.desc3: Sneak-click: change the range (3 to 8 blocks).
block.wayfarers.void_altar.desc: Use with a Void Shard to awaken the Void Warden.
block.wayfarers.warden_altar.desc: Use with a Map Fragment to awaken it.
block.wayfarers.waystone.desc: Right-click: open the travel map to any waystone your group discovered.
block.wayfarers.wireless_receiver.desc: Outputs redstone while a transmitter of its colour is on.
block.wayfarers.wireless_receiver.desc2: Right-click with a dye to pick its channel colour.
block.wayfarers.wireless_receiver.desc3: Works anywhere in the same dimension (chunks loaded).
block.wayfarers.wireless_transmitter.des: Sends the redstone signal it receives through the air.
Right-click with a dye to pick its channel colour.
Receivers of the same colour turn on.
gui.wayfarers.chisel_table.empty: Put a stack of blocks in the slot
gui.wayfarers.chisel_table.pick: %s variants - click one to convert the stack
gui.wayfarers.quests.title: Quest Journal
gui.wayfarers.skills.click_equip: Unlocked - click to equip it on V
gui.wayfarers.skills.hint: Click to unlock - quests, bosses and levels give points
gui.wayfarers.skills.title: Talents
gui.wayfarers.storage.deposit: Deposit the items this container already holds
gui.wayfarers.storage.nearby: Quick-stack into chests within 8 blocks that already hold those items
gui.wayfarers.terminal.empty: No chest within %s blocks. Put the terminal in your storage room.
gui.wayfarers.tip.title: Tip
gui.wayfarers.waystones.empty: Discover other waystones to travel between them. Every waystone found by anyone in the group appears here.
gui.wayfarers.waystones.hint: Double-click to travel - star to pin
gui.wayfarers.waystones.title: Waystones
guide.wayfarers.airship_compass.p0: Right-click to find the nearest Sky Harbour (in the End: the Void Ship Wreck). Its aether needle then keeps pointing there.
guide.wayfarers.airship_compass.title: Airship Compass
guide.wayfarers.armor.p0: Wear all four pieces of a set to get its bonus: Explorer (speed, soft landings, night vision underground), Ember (fire immunity) and Void (slow fall, saved from the void).
guide.wayfarers.armor.title: Armour sets
guide.wayfarers.backpack.p0: Right-click to open 27 extra slots that travel with you. Keep it in your hand to use it.
guide.wayfarers.backpack.title: Travel Backpack
guide.wayfarers.blood_moon.p0: Every few nights a Blood Moon rises: monsters are much stronger and elites much more common. Stay together, light your base and wait for dawn.
guide.wayfarers.blood_moon.title: Blood Moon
guide.wayfarers.bosses.p0: The big structures hide a boss arena behind a wall of mist. Walk through the mist to wake the boss: the mist seals until the fight ends.
guide.wayfarers.bosses.p1: Watch the wind-ups: every attack is announced by an animation or a circle on the ground. Hit it after a big attack, and break its poise to stagger it.
guide.wayfarers.bosses.p2: If everyone leaves the arena, the boss heals and goes back to sleep.
guide.wayfarers.bosses.title: Bosses
guide.wayfarers.chisel.p0: Right-click a block to carve it into the next variant of its family: stone, bricks, mossy, cracked, chiseled... Sneak-right-click goes back. Each cut uses one durability.
guide.wayfarers.chisel.p1: Stairs, slabs and walls keep their shape; copper keeps its age and wax. Works on vanilla stone, deepslate, tuff, sandstone, quartz, prismarine, blackstone, terracotta, copper and the Wayfarers blocks.
guide.wayfarers.chisel.p2: Some steampunk variants only exist through the chisel: brass tiles, engraved brass, brass grille, copper tiles, dark iron bricks, mahogany parquet...
guide.wayfarers.chisel.title: Engraver's Chisel
guide.wayfarers.chisel_table.p0: Right-click the table and put a whole stack of blocks in its slot: every variant of the family appears on the right.
guide.wayfarers.chisel_table.p1: Click a variant to turn the whole stack into it. It is free and the table never wears out.
guide.wayfarers.chisel_table.title: Chisel Table
guide.wayfarers.compass.p0: Use it to point to the nearest Wayfarers structure you have not explored yet.
guide.wayfarers.compass.p1: Sneak-use to switch the kind of structure it looks for.
guide.wayfarers.compass.title: Structure Compass
guide.wayfarers.crate.p0: A crate holds 32 stacks of a single item and shows it on its front with the count. Right-click with an item to put it in; right-click twice quickly to put in every one you carry.
guide.wayfarers.crate.p1: Left-click takes a stack (sneak: a single item). Hoppers, the Guild Terminal and quick-stack treat crates like chests that accept only their item.
guide.wayfarers.crate.title: Compacting Crate
guide.wayfarers.danger.p0: Monsters get stronger the further you travel from spawn, below sea level, in the Nether and in the End. The current level shows above your hotbar when it changes.
guide.wayfarers.danger.p1: Elites have a gold name and a gold frame on their health bar. They hit hard but drop materials, emeralds and sometimes a Recall Scroll.
guide.wayfarers.danger.title: Danger levels
guide.wayfarers.glider.p0: Hold it in either hand and jump from somewhere high: it opens by itself. You sink slowly and glide where you look, and landing never hurts.
guide.wayfarers.glider.p1: With the Grappling Hook: climb a tower, then glide to the next one. It wears in flight; repair it with brass.
guide.wayfarers.glider.title: Brass Glider
guide.wayfarers.grapple.p0: Right-click to fire the claw up to 32 blocks. When it bites a block, the chain reels you in; a small hop at the end lifts you onto the ledge.
guide.wayfarers.grapple.p1: Sneak or right-click again to let go. No fall damage while reeled in, nor just after.
guide.wayfarers.grapple.title: Grappling Hook
guide.wayfarers.grave.p0: When you die, your belongings are kept in a grave where you fell. Its coordinates are sent in the chat.
guide.wayfarers.grave.p1: Right-click the grave to get everything back. A friend can also recover it for you.
guide.wayfarers.grave.title: Graves
guide.wayfarers.guild_terminal.p0: Place it in your storage room: it shows everything stored in the chests within 12 blocks as one grid, with a search box. No cables, no power.
guide.wayfarers.guild_terminal.p1: Click an item to take a stack (right-click: half, middle-click: one, shift-click: straight into your inventory). Click the grid with an item, or shift-click your inventory, to store it. Store all and Store matching empty your inventory in one click.
guide.wayfarers.guild_terminal.p2: Sneak-right-click the terminal to sort every chest around it at once.
guide.wayfarers.guild_terminal.title: Guild Terminal
guide.wayfarers.harvest.p0: Right-click a ripe crop (wheat, carrots, potatoes, beetroots, nether wart, cocoa...) to harvest it and replant it in one go.
guide.wayfarers.harvest.title: Right-click harvest
guide.wayfarers.keys.p0: J: quest journal.  K: talent tree.  V: active talent.  R: sort your inventory.  M: magnet ring.  G: Builder's Wand symmetry.
guide.wayfarers.keys.p1: All keys can be changed in Options > Controls > Wayfarers.
guide.wayfarers.keys.title: Keys
guide.wayfarers.machines.p0: No cables, no power: each machine is one block that does one job. Hover a machine in your inventory to read what it does.
guide.wayfarers.machines.p1: A simple farm: Sprinkler in the middle of the field, Auto-Harvester at the edge with a chest against it. Wheat, carrots, potatoes, beetroots, nether wart, cocoa, melons, pumpkins, sugar cane, cactus and bamboo all work.
guide.wayfarers.machines.p2: Vacuum Hopper above a chest: it collects everything dropped around it, even experience.
guide.wayfarers.machines.title: Farm machines
guide.wayfarers.magic.p0: Magic is simple: each staff holds one spell. Right-click to cast it. Spells cost mana, shown in the blue bar above your experience; it refills by itself.
guide.wayfarers.magic.p1: Fire bolt, frost nova, Tesla lightning, mending, levitation, ward and steam blast: craft them with amethyst. The Arcanist talents give more mana, faster regeneration and stronger, cheaper spells.
guide.wayfarers.magic.p2: Carry an Arcane Ring (+50 mana) or a Mana Amulet (faster regeneration): no slot needed.
guide.wayfarers.magic.title: Magic
guide.wayfarers.magnet.p0: While it is in your inventory and switched on (it glows), items and experience within 7 blocks fly to you.
guide.wayfarers.magnet.p1: Right-click it or press M to switch it on or off.
guide.wayfarers.magnet.title: Magnet Ring
guide.wayfarers.materials.p0: Map Fragments come from Overworld ruins, Lithite from deep ores, Ancient Embers from the Nether and Void Shards from the End. They repair and craft the gear of each region.
guide.wayfarers.materials.title: Materials
guide.wayfarers.metal_armor.p0: Brass set: night vision and faster mining. Mithril set: +4 health and +10% speed. Aether set: +75 mana, mana refills twice as fast, no fall damage.
guide.wayfarers.metal_armor.p1: Arcanist robes are woven from Arcane Cloth (purple wool, string and an aether crystal): +100 mana and spells 25% stronger.
guide.wayfarers.metal_armor.title: Brass, mithril & arcane gear
guide.wayfarers.ores.p0: Zinc is common in stone (y -16 to 96). Craft 3 copper ingots + 1 zinc ingot into 4 brass ingots: brass tools are faster than iron and enchant well.
guide.wayfarers.ores.p1: Mithril hides deep in deepslate (below y -8, iron pickaxe). Aether crystals glow faintly between y -48 and 32. Orichalcum is found in the Nether. Smelt raw ores like iron.
guide.wayfarers.ores.title: New ores & brass
guide.wayfarers.quests.p0: The journal (J) lists five chapters. Each quest shows its objective, your progress and its rewards.
guide.wayfarers.quests.p1: Click Track to pin a quest to the top-right of your screen. When it is done, the tracker moves on to the next quest by itself.
guide.wayfarers.quests.p2: Progress is shared: when a friend completes a step, it counts for the whole group, even offline players.
guide.wayfarers.quests.title: Quests & journal
guide.wayfarers.recall.p0: Use it to return instantly to the nearest waystone of your dimension. Elites sometimes drop them.
guide.wayfarers.recall.title: Recall Scroll
guide.wayfarers.redstone_easy.p0: Redstone Timer: a ready-made clock. Click it to pick the delay.
guide.wayfarers.redstone_easy.p1: Tree farm in 3 blocks: Timer -> Block Breaker facing the trunk -> Block Placer with saplings below it.
guide.wayfarers.redstone_easy.p2: Wireless Transmitter and Receiver: dye both the same colour and the signal travels without wires. Entity Detector: opens doors or lights lamps when someone comes near.
guide.wayfarers.redstone_easy.title: Easy redstone
guide.wayfarers.refill.p0: When the stack in your hand runs out (last block placed, last food eaten, tool broken), the next stack of the same item from your inventory takes its place by itself.
guide.wayfarers.refill.title: Hotbar refill
guide.wayfarers.remembrance.p0: Every boss drops its Remembrance. Craft it with four materials of its region and two diamonds to forge its unique weapon, with a special right-click power.
guide.wayfarers.remembrance.title: Remembrances & boss weapons
guide.wayfarers.rivet_gun.p0: Right-click to fire a hot rivet: 5 damage, fast and nearly straight. Ammo: Rivets from your inventory, or iron nuggets.
guide.wayfarers.rivet_gun.p1: 12 Rivets: an iron ingot, a copper ingot and a zinc nugget.
guide.wayfarers.rivet_gun.title: Rivet Gun
guide.wayfarers.sorting.p0: Press R to sort your main inventory (not the hotbar or armour): stacks are merged and grouped.
guide.wayfarers.sorting.title: Sorting your inventory
guide.wayfarers.sorting_chest.p0: A big 54-slot chest that sorts itself when nobody is looking inside, and vacuums items dropped within 6 blocks.
guide.wayfarers.sorting_chest.p1: Sneak-right-click to sort it right now. Put one next to your mob farm or your mine entrance.
guide.wayfarers.sorting_chest.title: Sorting Chest
guide.wayfarers.steam_blocks.p0: Brass, copper and dark iron plating, clockwork and gauge panels, pipe bundles, Edison lamps, aether conduits, mahogany panelling, tufted leather and smokestack bricks. Most plates also come as stairs and slabs.
guide.wayfarers.steam_blocks.p1: Tip: keep brass for the trims and let dark iron and mahogany carry the mass; light it with Edison lamps.
guide.wayfarers.steam_blocks.title: Steampunk blocks
guide.wayfarers.storage_buttons.p0: Every chest, barrel or backpack shows small brass buttons above it: Sort, Take everything, Deposit the items it already holds, and Quick-stack into the chests around you.
guide.wayfarers.storage_buttons.p1: Type in the search box to light up the matching slots. Middle-click any slot to sort its inventory.
guide.wayfarers.storage_buttons.title: Storage buttons
guide.wayfarers.symmetry.p0: 1. Sneak-right-click a block with the wand: it becomes the mirror centre (sparks show the plane) and mirror X turns on.
guide.wayfarers.symmetry.p1: 2. Press G (or sneak-click the centre again) to switch: off, mirror X (east/west), mirror Z (north/south), mirror X + Z (4 ways).
guide.wayfarers.symmetry.p2: 3. Build as usual: gold outlines are your blocks, blue ones their mirrored copies (stairs turn the right way). Each copy costs a block; undo removes them all.
guide.wayfarers.symmetry.title: Wand symmetry
guide.wayfarers.talents.p0: Press K to open your talent tree: Warrior, Explorer, Arcanist and Engineer. Each talent costs points and needs one of the talents linked above it.
guide.wayfarers.talents.p1: You earn 1 point per quest, 3 per boss quest and 1 every 10 experience levels gained.
guide.wayfarers.talents.p2: The last talent of each branch is an active power: click it once unlocked to equip it, then press V to use it. A Vial of Oblivion gives every point back.
guide.wayfarers.talents.title: Talent tree
guide.wayfarers.tools.p0: The Excavator Pickaxe mines 3x3 and the Lumber Axe fells whole trees. Sneak to break a single block.
guide.wayfarers.tools.title: Special tools
guide.wayfarers.wand.p0: Hold the wand and look at a block: gold outlines show where copies will go. Right-click to extend that face with blocks of the same kind from your inventory (16 at a time, 64 with the Master wand).
guide.wayfarers.wand.p1: Made a mistake? Sneak-right-click in the air to undo the last use: the blocks come back to you.
guide.wayfarers.wand.title: Builder's Wand
guide.wayfarers.watch.p0: Its hand follows the sun, and a little window shows the sun by day and the moon by night.
guide.wayfarers.watch.p1: Right-click: time, day number, moon phase and the biome you stand in.
guide.wayfarers.watch.title: Pocket Watch
guide.wayfarers.waystones.p0: Right-click a waystone to discover it for the whole group and open the travel map.
guide.wayfarers.waystones.p1: In the map, click a destination then Travel (or double-click it). Pin your favourites with the star and rename them with the quill.
guide.wayfarers.waystones.p2: You can craft and place your own waystones at home, at your farms or at a dungeon entrance.
guide.wayfarers.waystones.title: Waystones
guide.wayfarers.welcome.p0: This world hides dozens of hand-built structures, dungeons and bosses. Your group explores it together: quests, waystones and discoveries are shared by everyone.
guide.wayfarers.welcome.p1: Press J (or use the Atlas) to open the quest journal, and follow the first chapter: it walks you through everything in this manual.
guide.wayfarers.welcome.p2: Hover any Wayfarers item in your inventory and hold W to jump to its page here.
guide.wayfarers.welcome.title: Welcome, Wayfarer
guide.wayfarers.wonders.p0: Three giant places wait to be found. The Clockwork Citadel: a steampunk town around a 75-block clock tower, in badlands, savannas, deserts and plains.
guide.wayfarers.wonders.p1: The Sky Harbour: an airship moored to an iron tower, seen from far away above the plains. The Undercity: a town on stilts in a vast cavern 12 to 30 blocks underground, around a glowing lake.
guide.wayfarers.wonders.p2: Sneak-use the Structure Compass to pick one of them, then use it to see the distance and direction.
guide.wayfarers.wonders.title: Wonders of the world
guide.wayfarers.wrench.p0: Right-click a block to turn it: stairs, logs, chests, hoppers, signs, machines, furniture. Sneak: the other way. Doors, beds and double chests stay put.
guide.wayfarers.wrench.p1: Sneak-right-click: a Wayfarers machine changes its setting; Wayfarers decoration or furniture comes back to your inventory.
guide.wayfarers.wrench.title: Brass Wrench
item.wayfarers.aether_boots.desc: Set: +75 max mana, mana regenerates twice as fast, no fall damage.
item.wayfarers.aether_chestplate.desc: Set: +75 max mana, mana regenerates twice as fast, no fall damage.
item.wayfarers.aether_helmet.desc: Set: +75 max mana, mana regenerates twice as fast, no fall damage.
item.wayfarers.aether_leggings.desc: Set: +75 max mana, mana regenerates twice as fast, no fall damage.
item.wayfarers.airship_compass.desc: Use: find the nearest Sky Harbour.
item.wayfarers.airship_compass.desc2: In the End: the Void Ship Wreck.
item.wayfarers.airship_compass.desc3: Its needle then keeps pointing there.
item.wayfarers.ancient_ember.desc: Still warm after a thousand years in the Nether.
item.wayfarers.arcane_boots.desc: Set: +100 max mana and spells 25% stronger.
item.wayfarers.arcane_chestplate.desc: Set: +100 max mana and spells 25% stronger.
item.wayfarers.arcane_helmet.desc: Set: +100 max mana and spells 25% stronger.
item.wayfarers.arcane_leggings.desc: Set: +100 max mana and spells 25% stronger.
item.wayfarers.bell_hammer.desc: Use: toll a ring of sound that staggers foes.
item.wayfarers.brass_boots.desc: Set: night vision and +20% mining speed (brass goggles).
item.wayfarers.brass_chestplate.desc: Set: night vision and +20% mining speed (brass goggles).
item.wayfarers.brass_glider.desc: Hold it while falling: it opens, you sink slowly
item.wayfarers.brass_glider.desc2: and glide where you look. No fall damage.
item.wayfarers.brass_helmet.desc: Set: night vision and +20% mining speed (brass goggles).
item.wayfarers.brass_leggings.desc: Set: night vision and +20% mining speed (brass goggles).
item.wayfarers.brass_wrench.desc: Use on a block: turn it (stairs, logs, chests, machines...).
item.wayfarers.brass_wrench.desc2: Sneak-use on a Wayfarers machine: change its setting.
item.wayfarers.brass_wrench.desc3: Sneak-use on Wayfarers decoration or furniture: pick it up.
item.wayfarers.builder_wand.desc: Use on a block: extend that face by up to 16 blocks from your inventory. Sneak-use in the air: undo. Sneak-use a block: mirror centre; G: symmetry mode.
item.wayfarers.chisel.desc: Use on a block: turn it into the next variant of its family (stone bricks, mossy, cracked, chiseled...). Sneak-use: previous variant. Stairs and slabs keep their shape.
item.wayfarers.crone_ladle.desc: Use: splash a lingering poison brew where you look.
item.wayfarers.crystal_fang.desc: Use: crystal spikes burst along a line.
item.wayfarers.ember_boots.desc: Set: fire immunity and faster in lava.
item.wayfarers.ember_chestplate.desc: Set: fire immunity and faster in lava.
item.wayfarers.ember_helmet.desc: Set: fire immunity and faster in lava.
item.wayfarers.ember_leggings.desc: Set: fire immunity and faster in lava.
item.wayfarers.ember_scythe.desc: Sets foes ablaze. Heals you in the Nether.
item.wayfarers.excavator_pickaxe.desc: Mines 3x3. Sneak to mine one block.
item.wayfarers.explorer_backpack.desc: Use: 54 extra slots. Craft it from a Travel Backpack and a brass ingot: nothing inside is lost.
item.wayfarers.explorer_boots.desc: Set: Speed, no fall damage below 8 blocks, night vision underground.
item.wayfarers.explorer_chestplate.desc: Set: Speed, no fall damage below 8 blocks, night vision underground.
item.wayfarers.explorer_helmet.desc: Set: Speed, no fall damage below 8 blocks, night vision underground.
item.wayfarers.explorer_leggings.desc: Set: Speed, no fall damage below 8 blocks, night vision underground.
item.wayfarers.fire_staff.desc: Spell (15 mana): a fire bolt that sets the target ablaze.
item.wayfarers.forbidden_grimoire.desc: Use: a beam of searing ink that blinds.
item.wayfarers.forge_king_hammer.desc: Use: a molten shockwave that sets foes ablaze.
item.wayfarers.frost_blade.desc: Slows foes; every third hit freezes them.
item.wayfarers.frost_staff.desc: Spell (25 mana): a frost nova that freezes and slows foes around you.
item.wayfarers.golden_mace.desc: Use: a golden quake that hurls foes into the air.
item.wayfarers.grappling_hook.desc: Use: fire the claw (32 blocks); it reels you in.
item.wayfarers.grappling_hook.desc2: Sneak or use again: let go.
item.wayfarers.grappling_hook.desc3: No fall damage while reeled in.
item.wayfarers.gryphon_lance.desc: Use: bound forward on the wind, scattering foes.
item.wayfarers.healing_staff.desc: Spell (30 mana): heals you and the players around you.
item.wayfarers.jade_fang.desc: Use: pounce forward, tearing through every foe.
item.wayfarers.kings_trident.desc: Use: a tidal ring that slows every foe around you.
item.wayfarers.levitation_wand.desc: Spell (20 mana): lifts the creature you aim at. Sneak: slow fall for yourself.
item.wayfarers.light_staff.desc: Use: burst of light that repels monsters.
item.wayfarers.lithite_shard.desc: A crystal that hums deep underground.
item.wayfarers.lumber_axe.desc: Fells whole trees. Sneak to cut one log.
item.wayfarers.magnet_ring.desc: Pulls nearby items while in your inventory. Use: toggle.
item.wayfarers.map_fragment.desc: Torn piece of an ancient map. Found in Overworld ruins.
item.wayfarers.master_builder_wand.desc: Use on a block: extend that face by up to 64 blocks. Sneak-use in the air: undo. Sneak-use a block: mirror centre; G: symmetry mode.
item.wayfarers.mithril_boots.desc: Set: +4 max health and +10% speed; feather-light.
item.wayfarers.mithril_chestplate.desc: Set: +4 max health and +10% speed; feather-light.
item.wayfarers.mithril_helmet.desc: Set: +4 max health and +10% speed; feather-light.

item.wayfarers.oblivion_vial.desc: Use: forget every talent and get all your points back.
item.wayfarers.pharaoh_flail.desc: Use: sand pillars burst along a line and weaken foes.

item.wayfarers.pocket_watch.desc2: Use: time, day, moon phase and biome.

item.wayfarers.rivet_gun.desc: Use: fire a hot rivet (5 damage).
item.wayfarers.rootmother_staff.desc: Use: roots seize and crush every foe around you.
item.wayfarers.sculk_horn.desc: Use: a sonic blast that pierces everything ahead.
item.wayfarers.soul_scythe.desc: Use: reap souls in a wide arc and drink their life.
item.wayfarers.steam_cane.desc: Spell (20 mana): a blast of steam that hurls foes back.
item.wayfarers.storm_staff.desc: Use: call lightning where you look.
item.wayfarers.structure_compass.desc: Use: locate the nearest Wayfarers structure. Sneak-use: change target.
item.wayfarers.telluric_hammer.desc: Use: shockwave that knocks enemies back.
item.wayfarers.thunder_staff.desc: Spell (35 mana): lightning that jumps between up to 4 foes.
item.wayfarers.travel_backpack.desc: Use: open 27 extra slots that travel with you.
item.wayfarers.void_boots.desc: Set: slow fall, and the void sends you back instead of killing you.
item.wayfarers.void_chestplate.desc: Set: slow fall, and the void sends you back instead of killing you.
item.wayfarers.void_greatblade.desc: Use: blink ahead and cleave everything around you.
item.wayfarers.void_heart.desc: It beats with the rhythm of the void.
item.wayfarers.void_helmet.desc: Set: slow fall, and the void sends you back instead of killing you.
item.wayfarers.void_leggings.desc: Set: slow fall, and the void sends you back instead of killing you.
item.wayfarers.void_shard.desc: A sliver of the space between the End islands.
item.wayfarers.void_spear.desc: Use: blink behind the creature you look at.
item.wayfarers.ward_orb.desc: Spell (40 mana): an arcane shield that absorbs damage.
item.wayfarers.wayfarer_atlas.desc: Use (or press J): open the quest journal.
item.wayfarers.wayfarer_manual.desc: Use: learn how every Wayfarers system works. Hold W over an item: open its page.
message.wayfarers.altar.busy: A guardian is already awake nearby.
message.wayfarers.blood_moon.end: Dawn breaks: the Blood Moon fades.
message.wayfarers.blood_moon.rise: The Blood Moon rises... monsters grow restless and strong. Stay together!
message.wayfarers.boss.defeated: %s has been defeated! The sealed bars crumble.
message.wayfarers.crate.empty: Empty crate: put any item in to choose its kind.
message.wayfarers.grave: Your belongings rest in a grave at %s %s %s (%s).
message.wayfarers.rivet_gun.empty: Out of rivets (Rivets or iron nuggets).

message.wayfarers.skill.nothing_to_forge: You have no talent to forget.
message.wayfarers.skill.point: New talent point! Press K to spend it.
message.wayfarers.skill.reset: Your talents fade away... every point is yours again.
message.wayfarers.void_saved: The void spits you back out.

message.wayfarers.wand.undone: Undone: %s blocks back in your inventory
message.wayfarers.waystone.too_far: Stand next to a waystone to use it.
message.wayfarers.welcome: Welcome, wayfarer! Your Atlas tracks the guild's journey — press [L] to see every quest.
message.wayfarers.wrench.cannot: Nothing to turn on this block.
skill.wayfarers.a_shield.desc: Active (V): absorb 12 damage for 15 seconds. Cooldown 45s.
skill.wayfarers.e_climber.desc: Step up full blocks without jumping.
skill.wayfarers.e_lungs.desc: Hold your breath much longer underwater.
skill.wayfarers.m_overdrive.desc: Active (V): 15 seconds of Haste III and Resistance. Cooldown 60s.
skill.wayfarers.m_tinker.desc: The item in your hand slowly repairs itself (1 point every 20s).
skill.wayfarers.m_tinker_2.desc: The item in your hand repairs faster (1 point every 6s).
skill.wayfarers.w_fury.desc: Active (V): 10 seconds of Strength II and Speed. Cooldown 60s.
skill.wayfarers.w_lifesteal.desc: Melee hits heal you for 8% of the damage dealt.
tip.wayfarers.blood_moon: A Blood Moon rises: monsters are much stronger tonight.
tip.wayfarers.boss_mist: Boss mist: walk through it to start the fight. It seals behind you.
tip.wayfarers.danger: The danger level rose: monsters here are stronger.
tip.wayfarers.elite: An Elite! Gold name, hits hard, drops good loot.
tip.wayfarers.grave: Your belongings wait in a grave where you fell. Right-click it to get them back.
tip.wayfarers.guild_terminal: Terminal: every chest within 12 blocks in one searchable grid.
tip.wayfarers.sorting_chest: Sorting chest: it sorts itself and pulls in nearby drops.
tip.wayfarers.waystone: Waystone discovered! Right-click it any time to travel.
